provenance.rule: Reduce each saved sequential input mask modulo 13; use chronological round order.

input.scope: One new fixed received word. No prior product, field cycle or list-decoding replay.

conventions.rank: sum a_i*q^i, coefficients in increasing degree order
conventions.distance: number of disagreeing retained coordinates, closed integer radius
conventions.candidates: distinct full codewords; punctured images are not deduplicated
